task_description: Configure the Omelasian Bible repo (savagemanage/omelas) so it can be deployed to GitHub Pages, with all 9 Korean-language books and their 54 chapters browsable from the site. Approach: MkDocs + Material theme (renders Korean, resolves relative .md links natively, needs no front-matter so prose stays untouched), built and deployed via a GitHub Actions Pages workflow. Do not modify novel prose or English originals; do not push or open PRs (orchestrator publishes; workflow files go via PR).

review.notes: v1 review APPROVED. Four non-blocking nits: (1) dead exclude_docs block in mkdocs.yml; (2) hand-maintained nav can drift if chapters are added; (3) DEPLOY.md PR-delivery note (accurate for the orchestrator's publish flow); (4) canon/ intentionally not published (it is supporting material, not a book). None are correctness issues; left as-is to avoid churn.

verification.tests: n/a (content repo; verification is a --strict site build)
verification.summary: python3 scripts/build_docs_tree.py && python3 -m mkdocs build --strict exits 0, output dir ./site. Verified: 54 chapter pages + 9 book index pages built, site/index.html has <html lang="ko"> and canonical https://savagemanage.github.io/omelas/, home page links to all 9 book indexes, relative .md chapter links rewritten to working URLs (e.g. ../chapter-01/). git status confirms no prose/English originals modified; no em dashes in new files.
